body:
Standardizing copyright listing, and for the licenses we should use SPDX identifiers.
Their "Modified" BSD-3-clause actually seems to be the standard ("New" or "Revised") BSD-3-clause from SPDX: https://spdx.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause.html

So we don't need to re-include it in this file explicitly, for our best effort compliance approach here the BSD-3-clause text is a match, even if it doesn't say "libjpeg-turbo Project" explicitly (SPDX marks this part as one that can be edited to match a project, while still being this license variant).

For the exact license terms to the letter, we still include the `LICENSE.md` file in the `thirdparty/libjpeg-turbo/` folder.

And for the IJG license the SPDX identifier is just "IJG".

```suggestion
Copyright: 2009-2024, D. R. Commander
 2015, Viktor Szathmáry.
 1991-2020, Thomas G. Lane, Guido Vollbeding
License: BSD-3-clause and IJG
```

The naming scheme here is like `git format-patch` (files should be renamed accordingly).
One patch was also missing. Finally, the PR which added these patches should be included for documentation, so we can find (hopefully) rationales for why these patches exist in the PR description or discussion.
```suggestion
- `0001-cmake-generated-headers.patch` (GH-104347)
- `0002-disable-16bitlossless.patch` (GH-104347)
- `0003-remove-bmp-ppm-support.patch` (GH-104347)
```

It seems like you converted the file back to ISO-8859, while I made it UTF-8 in my last PR.
This should be reverted (it's not part of our patch set because an encoding change can't be encapsulated in a patch file - my expectation is that upstream will accept to change that file sooner than later, otherwise I'll add an explicit sync step to convert encoding to UTF-8).

It was a lot of poking around and trial and error compiling to be honest. Some of the files were easy to exclude like the examples and the command line applications.

Some of them were for loading other formats, e.g. rdgif and wrgif for reading and writing gifs.

Some were for 16 bit jpeg support, e.g. the diffct, huff and lossls stuff which I removed to get the build size down.

Unfortunately stripping some of these files out also required a few patches to the main code.
